data.data_quality_notes: The prior year movement note provides an explicitly stated favourable run-off deviation of GBP 0.8m but does not state whether this figure is gross or net of reinsurance. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided; therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the stated run-off deviation (net fallback). A gross claims development triangle is present (page 30) but includes an aggregated "2012 & Prior" column which complicates direct PYD extraction; the triangle was not used as the primary source for the PYD figure.
